svg.aria-label: Career. Mar 2026 – Present: Enterprise Architect, Australia. Running my own practice and taking clients from business case through to delivery. Oct 2023 – Mar 2026: Engineering Manager, Asia Pacific, Australia & New Zealand. Leading the engineering team and owning the toughest customer escalations. Oct 2016 – Oct 2023: Senior Systems Engineer, Asia Pacific, Australia & New Zealand. Specialist on site for mining, retail and industrial rollouts. May 2015 – Oct 2016: Technical Systems Engineer II, Asia Pacific, Australia & New Zealand. Testing new products and rebuilding customer networks in the lab to find root causes. Oct 2014 – May 2015: Technical Systems Engineer, Australia & New Zealand. Trusted expert for wireless security and secure network rollouts. Feb 2014 – Oct 2014: Customer Operations Engineer, Australia & New Zealand. Lead on network and radio cases for government and mining customers. Feb 2013 – Feb 2014: Technical Support Engineer, Singapore & Malaysia. Hands-on support across servers, storage, networking and security. Nov 2011 – Jan 2013: Pharmacist, Malaysia. Clinical consultations and pharmacy operations.
